verdict.rationale: PagerDuty ships its own Post-Incident Reviews feature. Teams can start a PIR from the incident detail page or Slack after resolution, and it uses the incident lifecycle, Slack data, and the Scribe Agent to build chronological incident narratives, which covers drafting from the timeline. The evidence does not document postmortem templates, a review or approval step, or a publication step, so only about half the workflow is shown. Missing for 10: documented PIR templates, a review/approval workflow, a publication/sharing step, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineering leader, postmortems follow a real workflow — templates, drafting from the timeline, review, and publication

citations.quote: PagerDuty Post-Incident Reviews (formerly Jeli Post-Incident Reviews) allow you to turn incidents into learning opportunities.

Post-Incident Reviews integrate with your incident lifecycle, Slack data, and the PagerDuty Advance Scribe Agent to help your team uncover systemic patterns, build chronological incident narratives, and coordinate preventative follow-up actions
Teams can start PIRs directly from the incident detail page or Slack after resolving an incident
Transcribe incident meetings in real time to enhance incident summaries and post-incident reviews
